title: Railway Review (2026)
intro: Railway is evaluated here as IT & development software — Railway is a cloud PaaS / app platform (git-push services, databases, and usage-credited workspaces) from Railway Corp — not a managed WordPress host and not a Plesk/cPanel panel licence. Free Trial gives $5 credits for 30 days with no card. Free is $0/month with $1 usage credits. Hobby is $5/month including $5 credits and is the published research floor (startingPriceMonthly 5). Pro is $20/month per workspace including $20 credits (unlimited seats) — the production team floor above Hobby. Enterprise is custom. Same cloud-paas cluster as Render and Fly.io — Render remains the award (7.9); this entity does not outrank it. Peer of Heroku and Fly.io. Landscape-only versus WP Engine (managed WordPress). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Railway when a credited cloud PaaS with a published Hobby $5 floor is the job — not Render by default, and not WP Engine managed WordPress.
verdict: Choose Railway when a credited cloud PaaS with a published Hobby $5 floor is the job — not Render by default, and not WP Engine managed WordPress. Compare Render for the cloud-paas award path; Fly.io for PAYG microVMs; Heroku for Salesforce-backed dyno packaging; WP Engine only on landscape pages for managed WordPress. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Git-push dashboard plus Free/Hobby credited on-ramps are approachable; slightly less polished than Render’s award path. Not a lab test.
Cloud PaaS / app platform — ranked with Render, Fly.io, and Heroku, not WP Engine managed WordPress.
Services, databases, and git deploys cover the PaaS job; not a full CI product or Kubernetes control plane.
GitHub native deploys plus API cover the app-platform workflow.
Pro/Enterprise add governance; Hobby/Free are team-grade. Held at 7 versus enterprise clouds.
Pro workspace + Enterprise; Hobby $5 is not a large-estate Kubernetes story.
Published Hobby $5 floor plus Free $1 credits is a sharp PaaS entry versus Render Pro $25. Affiliate economics excluded.
No meaningful ITSM/dev AI copilot — scored low on purpose; PaaS job rarely needs AI scoring depth.
